Send any contributions to: Sisters of Diana, Inc., RR1, Box 42A, Tishomingo, OK, 73460. Loan contracts also honored.
entries.notes: Continuation of a listing from the previous page; name taken from the text ('Sisters of Diana, Inc.') but community_name left blank per instructions. Type Land Fund/Seeking Land: 'negotiations' and 'be on the land within 30 days' mean not yet on land. Mailing address is a rural route (RR1) but the group is not yet on the land, so land fields are left blank; land state is not stated either. No groups named.

entries.description: Four women live on 17 secluded acres in northern California with a small cabin. They seek other lesbian separatists to join them, build their own sleeping structure, and help with land payments. They hope dykes will buy adjacent land for sale. Lesbians passing through are welcome to visit.
entries.raw_text: FOUR WOMEN living on 17 secluded acres in northern California are looking for other lesbian separatists to join them. There's a small cabin but women interested in joining them need to build their own sleeping structure and help with land payments. They are hoping that dykes will buy the land adjacent to them that is for sale for $17,000 ($3,400 down). Dykes passing through northern California are welcome to visit. Contact Joanie, 3100 Ridgewood Rd., Willits, CA, 95490 - Phone 707 459-5776.
entries.notes: No name given; community_name uses opening words 'Four Women'. Type: four women already live on the land and recruit more ('looking for other lesbian separatists to join them'), so Intentional Community/Cooperative (three or more). Accepted: 'lesbian separatists' and 'dykes' = Lesbian women. Focus: Lesbian separatism named. Land address: street address 'Ridgewood Rd.' treated as land; no sign they live elsewhere. Residents 4 from 'FOUR WOMEN living on'. Acreage 17 held; the adjacent land for sale is not counted. Contact name Joanie.

entries.description: 160 acres southeast of Tucson bought by one woman for use by any woman. Women and children can rent space (an A-frame and camping land) nightly or monthly. Needs financial support; donors earn free camping nights. Mail to Cave Canyon Ranch.
entries.raw_text: NOURISHING SPACE FOR WOMEN is located on 160 acres 25 miles southeast of Tucson that a woman has bought to be used by any woman interested. There is space for women and children to rent (there is an A-frame and plenty of land to camp on) on a nightly or monthly basis. They need a lot of financial support so for every $2 a woman donates, she is entitled to one free night of camping available any time in her life. In return for a donation they will send information and directions. Send a stamped, self-addressed envelope to Cave Canyon Ranch, PO Box D-11, Vail, AZ, 85641.
entries.notes: Type: 'a woman has bought' the land, so Private/Individual Land (despite guest rental). Accepted: 'any woman' and 'women and children' before 1986 = Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women, Girl + Boy children. Land: PO box is not land; land state AZ inferred from 'southeast of Tucson'. Mail goes to Cave Canyon Ranch, which may be the land's name; no contact_name. Residents not stated.

entries.description: Women are squatting on a farm in Massachusetts and have been told to leave but are staying. They want the space for women only and need women to stay with them indefinitely, plus financial support.
entries.raw_text: ASHFIELD FARM WOMEN are "squatting" on a farm in Massachusetts. They have been told to leave but they are hanging on. They want the space for women - no men. They need women to stay with them indefinitely for this action; also financial support. Sorry we don't have all the information about this, but write to the Ashfield Farm Women, Samson Road Farm, Samson Rd., Ashfield, MA 01330.
entries.notes: Type: women already living on the farm and recruiting more; number not given, so Intentional Community/Cooperative is a judgment (a group, not one or two women). Accepted: 'space for women - no men' before 1986 = Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women; men excluded. Land address: road address 'Samson Rd.' used as land. Residents not stated.

entries.description: A feminist country retreat run by a collective of five women who open their house for workshops and discussion groups. Sliding-scale fees of $10 to $15 per day, scholarships, and negotiable child care. Collective members live together in the country.
entries.raw_text: WOMANSHARE is a feminist country retreat. It is run by a collective of five women who open their house for workshops to women seeking more about themselves and their lives. They say, "we feel that living with each other in the country has helped us to become stronger, healthier, more centered, and more creative. Some of the things we have been dealing with are our feminist politics, our sexuality and our own creativity. We know that we need contact with other women and we also need to find a way to survive economically in the country. Womanshare is our way of doing this." Fees are on a sliding scale from $10 to $15 per day. Scholarships are available and child care is negotiable. Include partial payment $10) when you register. The Womanshare Collective says, "we would like you to come and relax, join in discussion groups and workshops, enjoy good home-cooked food, and get to know us. We feel that being in the country, having a good time with other women can be aVery high experience." For more information, write Womanshare, 1531 Gray's Creek Road, Grants Pass, OR, 97526. Thanks to RUNES for this info.
entries.notes: Type: calls itself a 'feminist country retreat', so Retreat/Gathering Space. Residents 5 from 'collective of five women'. Accepted: women seeking workshops, before 1986 = Lesbian + Non-lesbian women; child care negotiable implies children, coded Girl + Boy children. Focus: Workshops/education ('workshops', 'discussion groups'). Land: road address used as land. Typo caution: raw text 'a VERY high experience' is printed 'a very high experience'.

entries.land_location_as_stated: in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York
entries.description: A country retreat for women in the Berkshire mountains with a large A-frame built by women, ten pasture acres for camping and access to 90 wooded acres. Two permanent residents. A-frame rents nightly or monthly; camping and work exchanges available.
entries.raw_text: WOMEN'S WAYS RETREAT is a place in the country for women to get in touch with our many ways of doing things. It is a special place where women may come together away from the daily hassles of the patriarchal society and experience the strength of a woman's culture. It is not a resort. Each woman who comes to the land makes a commitment to herself and other women thereby accepting responsibility for herself, as well as by respecting and supporting other sisters who are there. Womens Ways is located in the rolling Berkshire mountains in Craryville, New York. There is a large A-frame house built solely by women. There are ten pasture acres for camping and access to 90 wooded acres for hiking. At present there are two permanent residents. As for accomodations, it is possible to rent the A-frame on a nightly ($3.50 - $5) or monthly ($70.00 plus utilities) basis. Camping is available for $2.50 a night or $40.00 a month and access to the house and utilities is available. Work exchanges are also available, as there is never a lack of projects around. Write or call for reservations or information: Women's Ways, Andrews/Mulholland, RD1, Box 375A, Craryville, NY, 12521.- Phone 518 325-6612.
entries.notes: Type: calls itself a retreat, so Retreat/Gathering Space. Acreage 10 (pasture acres); the 90 wooded acres are only 'access to', so left out. Residents 2 from 'two permanent residents'. Accepted: 'women' before 1986 = Lesbian + Non-lesbian women. Focus Spirituality/ritual is weak; coded from 'experience the strength of a woman's culture'—a judgment call. Rural route (RD1) used as land. Contact name Andrews/Mulholland. Phone printed as '325-6612' with a smudged digit.

entries.description: A women's collective that bought a former mountain resort in September 1974 and runs it as a retreat for all women, on 23 acres in the Adirondacks with a main house, four cabins and a recreation facility. Open for days, weeks or months, and group reservations of up to 30. Sliding scale $10 to $25 a day.
entries.raw_text: A WOMAN'S PLACE began in September, 1974 when seven women pooled their resources, purchased a former mountain resort, and established a woman's collective dedicated to the support of a retreat for all women. Women are welcome to come for a day, a week, or a month, and A Woman's Place can also be reserved for groups of up to 30 women. A Woman's Place is situated on 23 acres in the Adirondacks; there is a main house where the collective women and their children live, four large nearby cabins and a recreation facility. The rates are on a sliding scale of $10 to $25 a day. Due to reservation demands, A Woman's Place needs a definite commitment on specific dates. Along with your reservations, please send a small deposit. Write to Mary Deyoe, A Woman's Place, Athol, NY, 12810 - Phone 518 623-9541.
entries.notes: Type: 'a retreat for all women', so Retreat/Gathering Space even though collective women live there. Residents: 7 from 'seven women pooled'; those were founders in 1974, so current count is uncertain; coded 7 as the collective plus children are not counted - judgment call. Accepted: 'all women' before 1986 = Lesbian + Non-lesbian; 'their children' = Girl + Boy children. No street address, so land city only from mailing town (Athol), land zip blank.

entries.land_location_as_stated: the Elwha River running through the back meadow
entries.description: Lesbians and gay men live on 78 acres owned by the gay community of Seattle, with a tipi, trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River. Three gay men live in the front houses, and two lesbians live near the forest. Land is for lesbians and gay men; the men would like to turn it over to dykes. Lesbians passing through welcome.
entries.raw_text: DEAREST WOMYN: For lesbians who are interested in country living, or passing thru and need a mellow atmosphere to stay in. We live in a 18' tipi on 78 acres with trees, hay, animals and the Elwha River running through the back meadow. The property is owned by the gay community of Seattle and presently has 3 faggots living in the up front houses, and we are back near the forest land. The land is for lesbians and faggots, however more lesbians would be nice and the men here would rather turn the total 78 over to the dykes. --KD & Barb Aehle - Rt. 3, Box 1708, Port Angles, WA, 98362 - PH. 206 452-2435
entries.notes: Type: more than two people live there (KD, Barb, 3 men) and they recruit lesbians, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. Residents 5 = KD and Barb plus '3 faggots'. Accepted: 'lesbians and faggots' = Lesbian women + Gay men ('faggots' read as gay men). Rural route used as land. 'Port Angles' printed as such (Port Angeles). Land owned by 'the gay community of Seattle'. Name 'Dearest Womyn' taken from opening salutation.
